word: We look at the sky as the sun goes down.
answer: Miramos el cielo mientras baja el sol.

word: She shows her dog the path to follow.

word: They need a short break after climbing the hill.

word: He forgets his water bottle again.

word: I pay for a cold drink at a small stand.

word: You practice slow breathing as you walk.

word: Later we are going to remember this peaceful moment.
